## The doctor runs on every push to the main branch, and the package checks it

WORKFLOW §12.2 said an outside reader finds a project's doctor result as the `context-doctor` check run on the main
branch's head, but never said the job must run on `push` to the main branch, and the installer only checked the job's
name. An adopting app that ran the job on `pull_request` only checked every change, yet its main branch had no
`context-doctor` check run, so `portfolio --source api` (and any outside reader) showed no doctor result.

- **WORKFLOW §12.2 and §12.4 step 4:** the job runs on `pull_request` and on `push` to the main branch, with no paths
  filter and no condition. The printed YAML is a whole workflow with its `on:` block; the same in the README, the
  `softure-doctor` skill and the managed rules block.
- **Doctor: new failure code `ci-doctor-trigger`** (never baselined) on a workflow under `.github/workflows/` whose
  `context-doctor` job (by id or `name:`) has no `push` trigger covering `mainBranch` (missing, `branches` without
  it, `branches-ignore` with it, tags only), a `paths`/`paths-ignore` filter on `push` or `pull_request`, or an `if:`
  on the job. `mainBranch` comes from `context/workflow.json`, else `main` or `master`. A project without the job
  gets no failure; the installer prints the missing job as before. The check lives in
  `skills/softure-doctor/scripts/ci_config.py` (a small YAML reader, no dependency; a file it cannot read is skipped).
- **Installer:** prints the `on:` block and what is wrong while the `context-doctor` job misses pushes to the main
  branch, the same way it prints the missing job; with no job at all it now prints a whole workflow, trigger included.
- **`routines/package-updates.md` step 4:** after a skills bump the run checks that the main branch's head has a
  `context-doctor` check run and, when the trigger is missing (or the doctor reports `ci-doctor-trigger`), fixes the
  workflow in the same pull request; the report's `Doctor` line names the check run.

Adopting apps: a workflow whose `context-doctor` job runs on `pull_request` only turns the doctor red with
`ci-doctor-trigger` after this bump. Fix it in the bump's pull request:

```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]  # your mainBranch
```

| Check | 0.30.0 | 0.31.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| job on `pull_request` only | doctor 0, installer silent | `ci-doctor-trigger`, installer prints the `on:` block |
| `push` to another branch, tags only, or `branches-ignore: [main]` | doctor 0 | `ci-doctor-trigger` |
| `paths` / `paths-ignore` filter, or `if:` on the job | doctor 0 | `ci-doctor-trigger` |
| `pull_request` + `push` to the main branch, no filter, no condition | doctor 0 | doctor 0 |
